reportTemplate.summary: In the saved dashboard {{v1}} (uid {{v5}}) I added the tag "{{v4}}" via Edit → Settings → General → Tags → Add, confirmed the current time range was Last 6 hours, then used Save dashboard and ticked the "Update default time range" checkbox (verified [checked] in the dialog's state diff) before pressing Save, which returned the "Dashboard saved" alert. Verification after a reload: the tag persisted (Settings → General shows the "{{v4}}" chip with a Remove "{{v4}}" tag button) and the dashboard's server-loaded JSON model (Settings → JSON Model tab, read only — no changes saved there) contains "tags": ["{{v4}}"] and "time": { "from": "now-6h", "to": "now" }, with version 3; loading the bare dashboard URL with no time parameters resolves the time picker to "Time range selected: Last 6 hours". Both existing panels ({{v2}} Notes with content {{v2}}, and {{v2}} Availability) are intact and I exited edit mode leaving the dashboard otherwise unmodified. Caveat: Grafana's built-in default time range is also the last 6 hours, so the time picker alone cannot distinguish an updated default from the built-in one — the JSON model's explicit "time" block (read from the server-loaded model) is what confirms the persisted default.
